title: Celsius or Fahrenheit
story:
NORA: UNIT MISMATCH. SENSOR GRID REPORTS CELSIUS. LEGACY DISPLAYS EXPECT FAHRENHEIT. FOURTEEN DISPLAYS SHOWING GARBAGE. CONVERTER SCRIPT FOUND AT /WORKSPACE/CONVERT.SH. NO IMAGE FOUND. NO OWNER FOUND.

Amara's script takes a Celsius value as its first argument and defaults to 0. Package it as `kestrel/converter:1.0` so the image behaves like a command: `docker run kestrel/converter:1.0 100` must print `212.0 F`, and with no argument at all it must convert the default 0 and print `32.0 F`.

The trick is making the arguments replace the default instead of being appended to it.
objectives: `docker run kestrel/converter:1.0 100` prints `212.0 F` (argument replaces the default)
startingState: `/workspace/convert.sh` exists and is executable. No Dockerfile has been written.
hints: Two Dockerfile instructions control what runs at start: one fixes the program itself, the other supplies default arguments that anything after the image name replaces.
Put the script in `ENTRYPOINT` using the JSON (exec) form, and the default value in `CMD`, also in JSON form. Whatever you type after the image name replaces `CMD` only.

```bash
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY convert.sh /app/convert.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/convert.sh"]
CMD ["0"]
EOF
docker build -t kestrel/converter:1.0 .
docker run --rm kestrel/converter:1.0 100
```

validation.description: With no arguments the image prints `32.0 F`
With the argument `100` the image prints `212.0 F`

solution:
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY convert.sh /app/convert.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/convert.sh"]
CMD ["0"]
EOF
debrief: `ENTRYPOINT` is the fixed program and `CMD` is its default arguments, which `docker run IMAGE args` replaces. Pro tip: `docker run --entrypoint sh` overrides the entrypoint itself when you need to debug an image.
